findings.finding: Only numeric non-disputed IDs enter panels. The current rendered values table therefore silently omits source N/A cells; bars should omit them but source tables should retain explicit missing entries and reasons.
findings.remedy: Keep missing_result_ids or resolve full source rows separately, display N/A in evidence table without plotting zero.
findings.resolution: Null cells retained in evidence tables; only numeric rows plotted. All-null groups retain records without empty figures.

findings.finding: GenomeOcean Table2 F1 chart is blocked by percent/% spelling, despite identical percentage values and valid comparisons.
findings.remedy: Reviewed unit-label alias must preserve original stored unit and numeric value; use display/compatibility alias with explicit provenance.
findings.resolution: Exact %/percent alias allows F1 panel; original stored values/units unchanged.

findings.finding: Number("") and Number(" ") are finite zero, so validation accepts blank numeric strings as plotted zero. Current batch has none.
findings.remedy: Reject strings whose trim() is empty before numeric conversion.
findings.resolution: trim-empty strings rejected before Number conversion.

findings.finding: Existing TAPE model IDs are reused for fluorescence/stability but same pretrained model rows on other tasks get new method IDs without family/uses_model associations. This leaves original TAPE model pages disconnected from their other tests. Task-specific heads must stay distinct, but reviewed architecture-family relationships can expose all relevant tests.
findings.remedy: Use explicit reviewed shared-model identity where justified, or add uses_model relationships for task-specific pipelines; do not infer from names across papers.
findings.resolution: All30 method/task occurrences map to six exact Table2 identities; untrained methods remain separate.
